items.title: Summer Mob Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Summer is here! These cute mobs are dressed for the sun and they're all so stylish! Just pick the one you like best and have a great skin for the summer!

+ 12 Skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Axolotl Jobs
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Have you ever seen a working Axolotl? Find your favorite job and get to work with these sweet skins!
WARNING: They are so cute and absolutely stunning!

+ Axolotl themed
+ 60 skins including 2 that are FREE
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Tokyo Mobs
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: These mob skins are ahead of our times in fashion and flare. 15 global influencers for street style. Electric-neon creepers, guardians, zombies and more. Dance right into these colorful trends!

items.title: Techno Mobs
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
It's the future and these Minecraft mobs just got a major robotic neon upgrade! Show off how much technology has evolved as you become your favorite advanced techno mob with cool color! Be sure to techno out with your very own ender dragon skin!

- 12 techno skins included!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: MOB CITY Mash-up
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Pick your favorite outfit skin, hop into your car and head downtown in Mob City Mashup!
Just watch out! Toy mobs and robots are raiding the city!
+ 6 mob skins
+ Massive city to explore
+ Modern resource pack for your own world

items.title: Serenity: Pastel Paradise
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Explore your worlds in a serene pastel experience.
Created by Tetrascape
items.changelog: Updated to Minecraft 1.21! Added textures for all new blocks, items, and entities. The resource pack is now better compressed for faster downloads, with various texture improvements.

items.title: Parkour Masters
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Parkour Masters is a Minecraft skin pack made for gamers that love to dash, flip, jump, and vault over obstacles to set all new records!


13 HD (128px) skins including:

- 1 free
- 12 parkour outfits


1 exclusive skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: K-Pop Teens
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Are you ready to sing in a band! Look the part as a K-Pop teen!

+ 19 skins included!
+ Inspired by K-Pop fashion!

items.title: Vividity
items.creator: Noxcrew
items.description:
Bring a vibrancy to your Minecraft adventures with the Vividity texture pack! With gentle, soft-focused details that give your textures a near-magical touch, your worlds will feel extraordinary!

Inspired by rustic fantasy games with a bold, vivid color palette, you’re about to feel like a true adventurer.

! Created for Noxcrew by THX
items.changelog: Updated for the The Garden Awakens 1.21 update! - Added Paintings, Trims, Bogged, Creaking and more - Added The Garden Awakens update blocks & items - Tweaked several other textures

items.title: Anime Summertime
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Do you like going out when the sun is shining bright? Get ready for summertime with these fashionable anime skins!

+12 cute outfits
+ 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Pizza Chef
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description: Have you ever wanted to craft your own pizza? Well now's your chance. With Pizza Chef by Project Moonboot you can invite your friends and create your own pizzas with this immersive pizza shop.

items.title: Rescue Mission: Shipwreck
items.creator: Jigarbov Productions
items.description:
OH NO! THE SHIPS ARE BEING DESTROYED BY A TERRIFYING KRAKEN!
You have one mission: Parkour and rescue all the villagers! What's worse, YOU CAN'T SWIM! Your arms are too blocky, of course.
+ Parkour, puzzles & exploration.
+ Unlock more difficult parkour ships.
+ Rescue everyone to unlock a speedrun timed mode.
+ Single & Multiplayer friendly.
By Jigarbov Productions
items.changelog:
- Updated to support Vibrant Visuals.
- Other minor bug fixes and adjustments.

items.title: End Tower
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: Create your path to the ender dragon! With plenty of challenges, parkours, mazes and mob fights, the end tower is the right place to challenge yourself in an epic journey.

items.title: SCP Escape Room
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
SCP-966 are creatures invisible to the naked eye that prey on humans when they're tired. Five 966 escaped containment inside the facility, forcing us to evacuate... but we forgot you in the process. Can you solve the mysteries of the facility and escape before it's too late?

+ Challenging SCP Puzzles
+ Skin pack

items.title: GrungeBDcraft
items.creator: BDcraft
items.description:
Transforms your wold in to comic book with a semi-realistic, gritty feel.
All the blocks, items, and mobs are finely detailed and shaded, giving textures a mixed theme between survival and horror...

- 256x, 128x, 64x, and 32x resolutions
- Supports the Chase the Skies update
- By: BDcraft / Sphax

*4GB+ of VRAM recommended*
items.changelog: - A MASSIVE update which adds support for all "The Garden Awakens", "Spring to Life", and "Chase the Skies" items, blocks, and mobs!

items.title: Parkour Heroes
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description:
Prepare yourself for a difficult and technical parkour adventure. Can you beat all 15 levels, defeat the bosses and find the 6 sets of hero gear left behind by previous adventurers? 

- Multiplayer
- Realm friendly, just load it up and it runs itself
- PVP arenas included
- 2 skins included, 1 skin free
- Custom textures
- Custom music

items.title: Hidden Bunker Lab
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Welcome to the hidden lab! You are now in charge of these facilities. Make use of the valuable resources provided. Plan your next adventure from your new secret base!

- A huge underground lab to explore.
- Tons of resources available all around the lab.
- Play on your own or invite friends along!

items.title: Hidden Mountain Bunker
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You've stumbled upon an abandoned bunker, hidden deep inside a mountain. It's been undisturbed for a long time, but was left well stocked! Time to make this your new base of operations.

- Claim an awesome hidden bunker built into a mountain.
- Make use of all the free supplies you can find.
- Enjoy the facilities by yourself or with friends!

items.title: Simple Spawns Castle City
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
This is it! Castle City! A busy, bustling city that every rookie adventurer dreams of reaching. They say you can find practically anything you are looking for if you manage to make your way to the city’s massive castle.

+ Vibrant rich city to explore.
+ A castle with dozens of rooms full of loot.
+ An adventure you can share with friends!

items.title: Simple Spawns Mining Village
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
After hearing the tales of an abandoned mining village lost in the mountains, you, an avid pickaxe wielder with an eye for shinnies have decided to make your way up there and take a look for yourself. 
- A cozy mining town to spend your days in.
- A steep canyon with caves to explore.
- Bring a mining buddy with you!

items.title: Samurai Assassins
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Hone your bushido spirit and unsheathe your katana! Unleash the elements as a Samurai Assassin! 

- 10 Anime-inspired fantasy samurai!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from The Pocalypse Studios

items.title: Crazy Fashion 2021
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Fresh, clean, and modern! Crazy Fashion 2021 includes all the new styles to show your friends!

- 10 skins
- Pastel style
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Jobs
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
What is your dream job? Choose from 9 different jobs and life your dream alone or with your friends.

+ Police officer
+ Firefighter
+ Banker
+ Teacher
+ Doctor 
and more!

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Millionaire Dream Mansion
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description: A massive luxury mansion awaits you with stunning architecture and fully furnished interiors. Step inside and live your millionaire dream as you explore elegant rooms and breathtaking surroundings!
